what: MiLB fielding runs (MFR): fielding runs above the level-position average per 1,000 innings from MiLB play-by-play 2021 to 2026, shrunk by reliability and put on an AAA-equivalent scale. Descriptive; never a grade, rank or sort input.
claim: Validated once (MILB_FIELDING_RUNS_GATE): among players who debuted 2022 to 2024, pre-debut MFR ranked later MLB fielding runs at Spearman 0.26 with B-Ref rfield (203 players, LB95 0.11) and 0.20 with OAA (164 players, LB95 0.03). Not shown to add to the scouting field grade (that read was underpowered).
